fomod.Name: Defeat and Capture
fomod.Author: Innocento
fomod.Description:
Losing a fight doesn't have to mean dying or reloading.
When you go down, the NPC standing over you takes you prisoner instead of finishing you. Their whole side immediately stops attacking, your gear is taken, and you stay exactly where you are - alive, disarmed, and someone else's problem. Anyone who was fighting THEM keeps fighting: a capture is one side winning, not the world agreeing to stop.
ALPHA. Tested and working, but not yet tested widely. Expect rough edges and please report them.
Built for SkyrimNet users first: captivity is a state the AI can see, reason about, start and end. It works completely on its own too, and the optional modules exist mainly so players without an AI framework have something to play against.
Hard requirements: SKSE64, PapyrusUtil. For the MCM: SkyUI and MCM Helper. Everything else is detected at runtime - absent mods are skipped, not errored.
